{
  "name": "hornhoof",
  "version": "0.34.0",
  "description": "Your own company of AI agents: any models, your own computers.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": "Ivan Korol",
  "private": true,
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/invariant0x/hornhoof.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/invariant0x/hornhoof/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/invariant0x/hornhoof#readme",
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": [
    "packages/*",
    "apps/*"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "prepare": "node -e \"const fs=require('node:fs');if(fs.existsSync('node_modules/@vitest/coverage-v8'))for(const w of['packages/protocol','apps/node','apps/server','apps/web']){fs.mkdirSync(w+'/node_modules/@vitest',{recursive:true});fs.rmSync(w+'/node_modules/@vitest/coverage-v8',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.symlinkSync('../../../../node_modules/@vitest/coverage-v8',w+'/node_modules/@vitest/coverage-v8')}\"",
    "lint": "npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && npm run lint:part --workspaces --include-workspace-root --",
    "lint:part": "eslint --ignore-pattern \"apps/**\" --ignore-pattern \"packages/**\"",
    "release:version": "node scripts/release-version.mjs",
    "test:release": "node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs",
    "check:author": "node scripts/author-check.mjs",
    "deps": "node scripts/deps.mjs",
    "test:related": "vitest related --run",
    "typecheck:tests": "npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/node/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "test": "node scripts/check-release.mjs --local && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run -s build -w @hornhoof/node && npm run test:release && vitest run",
    "test:real": "npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && npm run test:real -w @hornhoof/server",
    "test:lab": "npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && npm run test:lab -w @hornhoof/server",
    "build": "npm run build --workspaces --if-present",
    "dev": "npm run dev -w apps/server"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@typescript/native": "npm:typescript@^7.0.2",
    "eslint": "^10.14.0",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.72.1"
  }
}

files.CHANGELOG.md:
# Changelog

Newest releases come first. Each release starts with `## [X.N.P] - YYYY-MM-DD` and is one short list in English: one
line per entry under `### Fixed`, `### Added` and `### Changed`, in that order, with no summary and no translation. A
step people must take before updating is the first entry under Changed, starting with "Before you update:". The middle
number is the turn; the last counts releases between turns. Releases before 0.31.0 keep their older form.

## [Unreleased]

### Fixed

- Tracker lists give task titles more room, task cards use smaller headings, department stages drop repeated links and use matching status wording, and pipeline names wrap beside their chevrons.
- The README animations show the current map, department routes, tracker, task cards and agent windows.
- Task list rows line up the subtask arrow, status and details with the first line of the title, and show the task number and wait note underneath.
- Task lists give titles more room by sizing the other columns to their content and using smaller text on desktop.
- On phones, task details stack under the title and long text wraps within the list.
- Removed computer access details from agent windows, including the orchestrator's window.
- The file link check no longer fails about one run in sixteen, because it now changes a character of the signature that always counts.
- Telegram sends only the finished answer and its files, in the language you write to the bot.

### Added

- The Media workflow captures the current map, Startup department, tracker list, task card and agent window at desktop and phone widths in light and dark.
- Departments open on their products, linked routes, permanent agents and one-shot call places, even before a model is set up.
